description:
This integration package provides content required to integrate SAP Cloud Integration (Neo environment) or SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Foundry environment) with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance and the Colombian tax authority, DIAN. The integration is required to enable exchanging electronic documents with DIAN and to support follow-up operations, such as sending documents, getting statuses or signing. The integration package is available for SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition.

title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud for Procurement Integration with SAP S/4HANA Cloud for Sales or SAP ERP
description:
For purchasing organizations whose suppliers use the traditional intermediate document (IDoc) for their data exchange, this integration package provides integration flows using a set of robust application programming interfaces APIs and transform them into the corresponding IDoc to simplify and automate exchanging procurement documents.
The following documents and functions are supported in SAP S/4HANA Cloud:

 Create, change, cancel purchase order or customer return (outbound message)
 Create purchase order with advance variant configuration (AVC) (outbound message)
